title: feat: route GLM-5.3 Flash through Fireworks
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Routes canonical z-ai/glm-5.3-flash directly to Fireworks serverless accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p3-flash.
- Sets paidOnly to false; preserves multiplier 1, 1,048,576 context, text/image input, tools, mandatory reasoning, and no fallback.
- Updates exact Fireworks rates to $0.15 input/image input, $0.029 cached input, and $0.50 output per million; this intentionally replaces the roughly half-price OpenRouter sheet.
- Direct and full local E2E passed reasoning, JSON, tools, ten-image vision, streaming, native routes, prompt/output cache, errors, both wallet paths, exact Tinybird settlement, and 10/10 bursts.

Pricing: https://fireworks.ai/models/fireworks/glm-5p3-flash
